title: DOW-UAP-PR111, Unresolved UAP Report, Eastern United States, 2020
what_is_it: A US military infrared video clip (about one minute) submitted as an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) report, accompanied by an official written description of what the footage shows.
interpretation_warnings: The official description explicitly states it should not be read as an analytical judgment: 'Readers should not interpret any part of this description as reflecting an analytical judgment.'
No PDF text was extractable; extraction relies on war.gov metadata and the released video description only.
The 'areas of contrast' are unidentified — the footage is labelled unresolved and no explanation, object identity, distance, size, or speed is established.
Single-source, single-sensor infrared footage; infrared imagery can register birds, balloons, aircraft, or sensor artefacts that appear anomalous without corroborating data.
Location is given only broadly as 'Eastern United States' and the date only as the year 2020.

key_facts.source_quote: aboard a U.S. military platform in 2020
